title: "Regression Analysis"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(nnet)
library(modelr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load}
df = read_csv("data/liver_clean.csv")
```

## Treatment Type

For HCC, how baseline characters influence patients' treatment intent
```{r}

df_hcc_model = df |>
  filter(cancer_type == "HCC", !is.na(treatment_intent)) |>
  drop_na(age, sex, ps, tumor_size, tnm_stage, etiology) |>
  mutate(
    curative = ifelse(treatment_intent == "Curative", 1, 0),
    stage_group = ifelse(tnm_stage %in% c("I", "II"), "Early (I-II)", "Advanced (III-IV)"),
    stage_group = factor(stage_group, levels = c("Early (I-II)", "Advanced (III-IV)")),
    sex = factor(sex),
    etiology = factor(etiology) 
  )
fit_hcc_etiology <- glm(
  curative ~ age + sex + ps + tumor_size + stage_group + etiology,
  data = df_hcc_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(fit_hcc_etiology)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(fit_hcc_etiology), confint(fit_hcc_etiology)))
```

For ICC, exclude etiology as most of them are NA
```{r}
df_icc_model = df |>
  filter(cancer_type == "ICC", !is.na(treatment_intent)) |>
  drop_na(age, sex, ps, tumor_size, tnm_stage) |>
  mutate(
    curative = ifelse(treatment_intent == "Curative", 1, 0),
    stage_group = ifelse(tnm_stage %in% c("I", "II"), "Early (I-II)", "Advanced (III-IV)"),
    stage_group = factor(stage_group, levels = c("Early (I-II)", "Advanced (III-IV)")),
    sex = factor(sex)
  )
fit_icc_etiology <- glm(
  curative ~ age + sex + ps + tumor_size + stage_group,
  data = df_icc_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(fit_icc_etiology)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(fit_icc_etiology), confint(fit_icc_etiology)))
```
